newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian shrs end mixed in calm trade.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian shrs end mixed in calm trade.

text.p: Hungarian share prices closed mixed in trendless, calm trade what traders attributed to scaled down activity of foreigners on expectations for a U.S. interest rate rise.
"The market was trendless, investors wait for a U.S. rate hike," said Tamas Revesz of Gog Securities. "Until there's a decision on this, nobody will do anything," he said.
The modest turnover of 687.3 million forints well reflected investors' hesitance, traders said.
The BUX index closed at 3,529.14 points, down 2.83.
BUX index futures firmed for all maturities, by between seven to 115.50 points.

In mostly modest turnovers, some shares rose to hit new highs, including pharmaceuticals Human which peaked and closed at 2,680 forints, up 80 and chemical firm which found a support at 3,000 forints.
After rising to a new high of 3,020 forints, Borsodchem closed steady at 3,000.

Compensation coupons, rallying in the past few days amid domestic investors' speculation, soared to a new 52-week high of 697 forints, but fell back to 671 forints, down two. -- Emese Bartha, Budapest newsroom (36 1) 327-4040
